economia|asia.title: China's hypercompetition goes global as Beijing frets over backlash
economia|asia.summary: China's intense industrial competition expands globally as Beijing faces potential backlash from other countries. The hypercompetitive approach threatens international economic relations.

economia|asia.title: Putin, Xi to meet on sidelines of SCO summit Monday, Kremlin says
economia|asia.summary: Putin and Xi will meet Monday on the sidelines of the SCO summit, according to the Kremlin. The meeting signals continued bilateral cooperation between Russia and China.

economia|asia.title: 藥華藥 Ropeg 繼台、日之後拿下美國 ET 藥證 未來搶攻逾400億美元新市場
economia|asia.summary: 药华药Ropeg新药获美国FDA批准用于治疗原发性血小板过多症。该药已在台湾和日本获批，公司将进入逾400亿美元的全球市场。

economia|asia.title: Japan's Sumitomo joins copper-gold mine project in Chile
economia|asia.summary: Japan's Sumitomo joined a copper-gold mining project in Chile. The investment expands Japan's resource security in South America.

economia|europa.title: Isabel Schnabel: Central banks on-chain
economia|europa.summary: Central banks are exploring blockchain technology according to Isabel Schnabel. The development could reshape monetary policy infrastructure.

economia|europa.title: La elevada inflación de agosto siembra dudas sobre el mecanismo de contención de precios del Gobierno
economia|europa.summary: La inflación alcanzó el 4,3% en agosto impulsada por carburantes. Los analistas advierten sobre posibles aumentos en precios de gas y electricidad en otoño.

economia|europa.title: El desánimo político alemán amenaza a la tímida recuperación
economia|europa.summary: Merz es el canciller alemán peor valorado en treinta años antes de elecciones en Sajonia-Anhalt. La AfD roza el 42% de los votos en la región.

economia|europa.title: France Dodges Rating Rebuke as Fitch Sticks With Stable Outlook
economia|europa.summary: Fitch Ratings maintained France's stable outlook despite warnings about widening deficits and mounting debts. Political uncertainty remains a concern for future downgrades.

economia|america.title: Trump says US to take control of 65bn barrels of Venezuelan oil
economia|america.summary: Trump announced the US will control 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil through a joint venture. The deal aims to lower petrol prices for Americans.

economia|america.title: Where the US-Canada Trade War Stands After Talks Fell Apart
economia|america.summary: US-Canada trade talks collapsed abruptly, triggering sharp escalation in tensions between the nations. The dispute threatens bilateral economic relations.

economia|america.title: Finance Chief Says Colombia Must Slash Spending or Face ‘Abyss’
economia|america.summary: Colombia's Finance Minister pledged to slash government spending to address a fiscal crisis. He described it as possibly the worst in the nation's history.

economia|america.title: Warsh’s Inflation Warning Sets Up September Showdown for the Fed
economia|america.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh warned strongly about inflation, setting up September's policy meeting as pivotal. The Fed faces pressure to continue fighting price increases.

politica|asia.title: Number of missing in Nepal and China floods soars to nearly 3,000
politica|asia.summary: Nearly 3,000 people are missing after floods in Nepal and China; up to 93,000 affected. The Red Cross describes the disaster's trauma as enormous.

politica|asia.title: 伊朗總統承認美國制裁衝擊經濟 傳釋出願意讓步訊號
politica|asia.summary: 伊朗总统裴澤斯基安承认美国制裁对伊朗经济造成打击。这与他数天前坚称制裁无效的立场相矛盾，传释出让步信号。

politica|asia.title: 尼日國家電視台斷訊 機場、總統府附近激烈槍響
politica|asia.summary: 尼日首都尼阿美机场附近和总统府一带传出激烈枪响，国家电视台上午断讯。机场今年已两度遭圣战分子攻击。

politica|asia.title: China removes high-ranking officers from key military body
politica|asia.summary: China removed high-ranking officers from its Central Military Commission. Zhang Youxia, the nation's highest-ranked general, lost his position.

politica|asia.title: 菲律賓連日大雨成災 至少40死、800萬人受影響
politica|asia.summary: 菲律宾自8月初连续受台风和西南季风影响，至少40人丧生。超过800万人生活受影响，吕宋岛还将持续降雨。

politica|europa.title: Dozens dead after Russian strike on depot near Kyiv
politica|europa.summary: A Russian strike on a depot near Kyiv killed dozens; the facility stored explosives. The blast damaged residential areas, a care home, and surrounding infrastructure.

politica|europa.title: Norway's King Harald dies at 89
politica|europa.summary: Norway's King Harald died at age 89. His son became King Haakon VIII, with Crown Princess Mette-Marit now serving as queen.

politica|europa.title: Serbia: Keeping EU, Russia in play ahead of key election
politica|europa.summary: Serbia balances EU ambitions with Russian ties ahead of a key election. President Vucic navigates growing geopolitical tensions and domestic pressure.

politica|europa.title: What next? Kurds say yes, Druze still say no to united Syria
politica|europa.summary: The Druze minority in Syria is the only group refusing central government authority. The end of an independent Kurdish area impacts future Druze decisions.

politica|europa.title: Public funerals honor fallen PKK fighters in Turkey
politica|europa.summary: Public funerals honored fallen PKK fighters in Turkey since August 21. Around 100 fighters killed in recent fighting were memorialized.

politica|america.title: U.S. says pipelines will make Strait of Hormuz irrelevant. Energy experts disagree
politica|america.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent claimed pipelines will make the Strait of Hormuz irrelevant within two years. Energy experts dispute this timeline.

politica|america.title: Detroit despairs as ‘insanity’ of Trump’s Canada trade war punishes city
politica|america.summary: Detroit faces economic hardship from Trump's Canada trade war as midterms approach. Daily $1 billion in goods cross the river dividing the city.

tecnologia|asia.title: 美國司法部與FBI破壞中國駭客代理網路，查封QScan與QTRouter平臺
tecnologia|asia.summary: 美国司法部和FBI查封中国国家支持的黑客组织QTFY使用的QScan和QTRouter平台。行动阻断其对美国关键基础设施的攻击。

tecnologia|asia.title: OpenAI提出網路集體防禦行動，獲Google、Anthropic及微軟等上百家企業呼應
tecnologia|asia.summary: OpenAI发起网络集体防御行动，获Google、Anthropic、微软等百家企业响应。应对日益成熟复杂的AI驱动网络攻击威胁。

tecnologia|asia.title: Nvidia傳以129億美元併購Hugging Face
tecnologia|asia.summary: Nvidia同意以129亿美元收购开源AI平台Hugging Face。交易进度因不同媒体报道存在差异。

tecnologia|asia.title: Google推出Gemini 3.5 Transcribe轉錄模型，可整理口語並區分多名說話者
tecnologia|asia.summary: Google推出Gemini 3.5 Transcribe语音转文字模型，可整理口语并区分多名说话者。该模型已在Gemini API和企业版推出。

tecnologia|europa.title: Trump blacklisting of "woke" Anthropic deemed illegal by federal judge
tecnologia|europa.summary: A federal judge ruled Trump's blacklisting of AI company Anthropic illegal. Anthropic had refused to support lethal autonomous warfare and mass surveillance.

tecnologia|europa.title: Mientras sus beneficios caen un 42%, Xiaomi acelera en el terreno más caro de todos: los chips
tecnologia|europa.summary: Los beneficios de Xiaomi caen 42% mientras acelera inversión en desarrollo de chips propios. La empresa enfrenta crisis de componentes e inflación generalizada.

tecnologia|america.title: The Cybersecurity Apocalypse Is Coming in ‘Months,’ AI Giants Warn
tecnologia|america.summary: AI giants warn a cybersecurity apocalypse could occur in months. Hackers also targeted over 100 US water systems recently.

tecnologia|america.title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
tecnologia|america.summary: An Anthropic researcher demonstrated self-improving AI systems that enhanced performance on all 10 misaligned behavior benchmarks. Overall performance did not degrade.

tecnologia|america.title: Apple One and Apple TV subscription prices increase by up to 20 percent
tecnologia|america.summary: Apple increased subscription prices for Apple One and Apple TV by up to 20 percent. Annual Apple TV subscriptions received the largest price increase.

tecnologia|america.title: Meta makes AI glasses slightly less creepy with limit on nonconsensual recording
tecnologia|america.summary: Meta limited nonconsensual recording on its AI glasses by blocking recording when users cover the safety light. The fix addresses privacy concerns.

tecnologia|america.title: Authorities arrest 2 alleged members of prolific hacking group TeamPCP
tecnologia|america.summary: Authorities arrested two alleged members of prolific hacking group TeamPCP. The group infected over 1,000 organizations in supply-chain attacks.
